name: TROP
recent: Tropicana 近期持续进行股份回购，同时大股东 Tan Sri Dr Lim Wee Chai 与主席 Tan Sri Dato' Tan Chee Sing 均有股权变动申报，主席增持 1600 万股。公司 2026 年第二季转亏，但营收同比大幅增长。
notable: 主席 Tan Sri Dato' Tan Chee Sing 增持 1600 万股。
公司于 11 月多个交易日进行股份回购。
2026 年第二季由盈转亏，净亏损 590 万令吉。
risks: 2026 年第二季净亏损 590 万令吉，去年同期为净利。
大股东 Tan Sri Dr Lim Wee Chai 及主席 Tan Sri Dato' Tan Chee Sing 多次申报股权变动。
earnings: 2026 年第二季营收 8.508 亿令吉，环比增长 171.2%，同比增长 157.7%；净亏损 590 万令吉，净利率 -0.7%，较上季 -4.6% 收窄，但去年同期为净利。

recent_en: Tropicana has been actively buying back shares, while substantial shareholder Tan Sri Dr Lim Wee Chai and Chairman Tan Sri Dato' Tan Chee Sing have filed changes in interest, with the Chairman acquiring 16 million shares. The company returned to a loss in 2Q 2026 despite a sharp year-on-year revenue increase.
notable_en: Chairman Tan Sri Dato' Tan Chee Sing acquired 16 million shares.
The company swung to a net loss of RM5.9 million in 2Q 2026.
risks_en: Net loss of RM5.9 million in 2Q 2026 versus a net profit a year earlier.
Substantial shareholder Tan Sri Dr Lim Wee Chai and Chairman Tan Sri Dato' Tan Chee Sing filed multiple changes in interest.
earnings_en: 2Q 2026 revenue was RM850.8 million, up 171.2% QoQ and 157.7% YoY; net loss was RM5.9 million with a net margin of -0.7%, narrower than -4.6% in the prior quarter but versus a net profit a year earlier.
